leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the :focus-visible pseudo-class to style focus indicators for keyboard users
Configure CSS rules to differentiate between mouse and keyboard focus states
Implement accessible focus styles that meet WCAG contrast requirements
Construct fallback focus styles for browsers without :focus-visible support
Manipulate focus visibility based on user interaction modality
Integrate :focus-visible with existing focus management patterns
Update existing CSS selectors to prioritize :focus-visible over :focus
